text:
peter-sales: Heads up 3 Labyrinth Therapeutics signed an LOI and wants a 2-week POC next month. They want to run a custom Llama-variant (70B finetuned) in Dedicated EU. Asks: variant compatibility, KV cache persistence across restarts for very long conversations (~1M tokens), Azure Key Vault (customer-managed KMS), EU residency, and a rough cost sketch for ~100k tokens/day with p50 ~200ms. Who can triage?

lia-ml: I can own model compatibility checks. Q: does the model use a custom tokenizer? tokenization tweaks are the usual blocker.

peter-sales: Customer said "minimal tokenizer tweaks" and will send model card tonight.

rob-infra: Hosting is doable. For 70B we either need 8xA100-80GB (FP16) or quantize to fit fewer GPUs. KV persistence options: checkpoint KV shards to PVs (lower latency) or snapshot to object store and restore (simpler). Both feasible.

lia-ml: Need to confirm weight format (safetensors vs hf vs custom) and KV layout. Some variants change KV dtype/ordering which breaks our checkpoints. If they can tolerate q4_k_m or int8, memory drops a lot.

sarah-se: Security: they require EU-only residency and Azure Key Vault. We'll need Dedicated in EU and to wire our KMS plugin. Legal wants DPA and privacy contact.

devin-eng: For POC can do a canary route + fallback to a 13B open model. Don't promise SLA beyond best-effort unless they reserve nodes. Ops runbook and KV checkpoint cadence needed.

peter-sales: Can we give a quick blockers list + rough costs by Friday? They need to lock schedule.

rob-infra: Rough infra sketch:
Option A FP16 (8xA100): infra ~$18k/mo -> 2-week POC prorate ~$4.5k
Option B Quantized (4xA100/A30): infra ~$9k/mo -> 2-week ~$2.2k
Token incremental cost depends on batching; for 3M tokens/month infra amortized add ~$2-3 per 1M tokens. Excludes SE/legal/ops time.

sarah-se: Add 2-3 engineer-days for KMS+DPA+audit-log validation. If they ask for encryption-of-weights with customer keys that's additional scope.

devin-eng: Ops estimate 3-4 eng-days to build canary, fallback, PV sizing, and runbook. PV iops sizing required if checkpointing. I'll own runbook.

peter-sales: Actionable commit request: can we commit to (1) run variant on Dedicated EU with PV checkpointed KV, (2) integrate Azure Key Vault, (3) provide cost estimate and runbook? We need to reply to customer EOD Friday.

lia-ml: Yes, contingent on compatible weight format and KV layout. I'll start compatibility tests as soon as model card arrives; will run tokenizer roundtrip, sample generation, and KV restore sim. Expect initial pass in ~48h. I'll also post a short checklist.

rob-infra: Caveat: if the model requires custom attention kernels or nonstandard ops, that could add time. Also clarify Dedicated vs Private (on-prem).

peter-sales: Customer prefers Dedicated EU; I'll confirm if they insist on Private. I'll also request their prompt suite (50-100 prompts) for quality checks and the model card plus tokenizer details tonight.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] POC project created: project/labyrinth-poc. Tags: dedicated, eu, kms. Ticket: #POC-8421.

sarah-se: I'll draft DPA and send security checklist once I have privacy contact.

devin-eng: Owners & next steps:
- lia-ml: compatibility tests (48h)
- rob-infra: infra sizing + PV vs object-store decision + cost estimate (tomorrow)
- sarah-se: DPA & KMS preflight (tomorrow)
- peter-sales: collect model card, tokenizer details, prompt suite (EOD)
- devin-eng: ops runbook/canary (48-72h)

peter-sales: Thanks all 3 I'll ping if the customer wants a 30m technical call with their ML lead. :thumbsup:
